notes: μέν left unrepresented under rule 70, the answering δέ keeping its own *but*.
The second attributive article οἱ is unrepresented and the relativizer goes to συνοδεύοντες, the head noun ἄνδρες being expressed (rule 31).
συνοδεύοντες governs a bare dative, so *with* rides with αὐτῷ (rule 106's closing clause).
μηδένα → *no man* headed on *no*, *man* being the generic completion (rule 17).
